segments.name: Data Collaboration Platform
segments.description: Provides a data collaboration platform that lets marketers and media owners securely share, manage and activate first-party consumer data with partners.
segments.evidence: The Company has one primary business activity, its data collaboration platform, as described in the business description section of Note 1, "Organization and Summary of Significant Accounting Policies."

revenueModel.text: The company earns subscription fees from clients accessing its platform, revenue-sharing fees from data transactions through the LiveRamp Data Marketplace, transactional usage-based fees from publishers and addressable TV providers, and professional services fees.
